component.name: karakeep
component.description: TAPPaaS module karakeep: triage of the critical/high CVEs in its images (#842). Karakeep 0.34.1 runs as three containers on the karakeep VM: the web app with its background workers (port 3000, the only one published, behind the firewall's Caddy and Authentik sign-in), a headless Chromium and Meilisearch, both reachable only on the compose network. Verified live on hrossen: the web container runs only node server.js and node dist/index.js under s6. Debian base-image findings (ffmpeg, util-linux, perl, curl, ...) are left open for upstream image rebuilds.

analysis.detail: curl and libcurl from Meilisearch's Alpine base image. Meilisearch is a Rust binary linked only against musl and libgcc (ldd); it does not load libcurl. The container runs only tini and /bin/meilisearch, has no healthcheck, and nothing calls curl in it. Verified live on hrossen with Meilisearch v1.55.0.
